quests.title: After the Storm

dialogue.t: There's still much work to be done. I need to put my back into it...
So, did you manage to mine any ore?
Let me see. Huh. These crystal ores actually don't look half bad.
Here's your payment. Take it for your trouble.
So, this means that the storm around Stormterror's Lair has indeed dispersed. I should make time to go there myself soon...

quests.description: After Dvalin was cleansed, access to Stormterror’s Lair has been restored. Wagner would like to go there to look for precious Crystal Ore…
